id.description: The CatalogApp id this classification was assigned to, e.g. 'pacman-aur:wings3d'.

confidence.description: The LLM's own certainty in this classification. A three-level enum rather than a numeric score — self-reported LLM probabilities are poorly calibrated, so a finer scale would only pretend to precision. 'low' entries are kept for auditability but never applied (see llmClassificationMap).

reason.description: Why the LLM assigned this classification — for auditability.

model.description: The model that produced this entry, e.g. 'gemini-3.8-flash' or 'openai/gpt-oss-20b' — classify-llm rotates across config/llm-models.json's models to spread their free tiers' per-model quotas, so quality can be audited per model.

title: Enrich: LLM classifications
description: LLM-assigned type (app or game) and category for apps the deterministic signals couldn't classify — checked last in enrichApps, just before the 'To Classify' fallback. Generated by `pnpm classify-llm` (free-tier LLMs, see config/llm-models.json), committed and consumed at build time; never hand-edited.
